NOTE
**Still not ready — the manual-testing screenshots the feedback asked for are still missing**

New: The author swapped in publicly hosted before/after screenshots for two layouts (rows with an avatar or icon, and slash-command rows without one), but pushed no code. Missing: screenshots documenting the other manual checks (12px, default, and 20px font sizes), which they chose to leave as unshown spot checks, and the self-review boxes for responsiveness and for remaining concerns are still unchecked.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave it with laurynmm; no reviewer yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the public screenshots, they're much easier to compare. You mentioned testing at several font sizes (and your plan on #37030 called for it), so please add precise before/after screenshots for those too, per the [guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
